# `cbo_data_snapshots`

**CBO Open Data distribution provenance snapshots**

One provenance row per acquired US-CBO/cbo-data CSV distribution with commit SHA, publication ID, row count, and SHA-256 digests.

**Coverage.** Sampled. Every CSV distribution present in the pinned US-CBO/cbo-data commit; missing older CBO releases are not implied. *(measured 2026-11-27)*

- **Parquet file:** `cbo_data_snapshots.parquet`
- **MCP `query_sql` support:** Configured; requires an available artifact.
- **Publication status:** Not established by this schema page or its measurement date.
- **Row count:** Not stated here; the MCP `describe_table` reply gives the live count under `publication`.

| Column | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `dataset` | `VARCHAR` | CBO Open Data dataset identifier. |
| `vintage` | `VARCHAR` | Publication vintage (`YYYY-MM`). |
| `file_type` | `VARCHAR` | Distribution series or domain type. |
| `commit_sha` | `VARCHAR` | Pinned 40-character Git commit SHA in US-CBO/cbo-data. |
| `publication_id` | `VARCHAR` | CBO publication identifier. |
| `title` | `VARCHAR` | Dataset title from `schema.json`. |
| `source_url` | `VARCHAR` | Landing CBO publication URL from `schema.json`. |
| `source_file` | `VARCHAR` | Relative CSV path inside US-CBO/cbo-data. |
| `row_count` | `BIGINT` | Number of data rows parsed and emitted from `source_file`. |
| `source_sha256` | `VARCHAR` | SHA-256 digest of the exact source CSV bytes. |
| `schema_sha256` | `VARCHAR` | SHA-256 digest of the dataset `schema.json` bytes. |
| `catalog_sha256` | `VARCHAR` | SHA-256 digest of `catalog.json`. |
| `observed_at` | `VARCHAR` | UTC capture timestamp of the CSV acquisition. |
